entries.title: Successful page resolve JSON response.
entries.notes: Requires API installed, Layout Builder installed, and a seeded published page with a resolvable URL. Capture the JSON body plus `X-Capell-Api-Version`, `X-Capell-Cache-Tags`, and `ETag` headers.
entries.useCase: A frontend renderer resolves a published Capell page into public JSON for rendering outside the CMS.

entries.title: Page resolve layout graph JSON response.
entries.notes: Requires Layout Builder and a seeded page with bounded layout content. Verify public JSON does not expose authoring metadata, field paths, or signed editor URLs.
entries.useCase: A frontend renderer requests the bounded layout graph for a published page.

entries.title: Page resolve forbidden JSON response.
entries.notes: Optional non-2xx runner evidence. Requires a seeded published page and a runner that treats `expectedStatus` as the successful capture status for public JSON errors.
entries.useCase: A developer verifies unsigned explicit language selection returns the documented JSON error instead of leaking context.

entries.title: Page resolve not found JSON response.
entries.notes: Optional non-2xx runner evidence. Requires a runner that treats `expectedStatus` as the successful capture status for public JSON errors.
entries.useCase: A developer verifies unresolved pages return the documented JSON error contract.
